name: Ho Chi Minh City — District 1
attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Unmapped buildings from the Global Building Atlas (Zhu et al.), CC BY-NC 4.0.
axes: +X east, +Y up, -Z north, metres from the district centre
note: Buildings are LOD1 extrusions. OpenStreetMap footprints are kept. OSM building:part ways extrude each section at its own height, and the outline keeps only the uncovered remainder. Global Building Atlas footprints are added where they are not already an OpenStreetMap building, water surface, street, or pedestrian area. Streets are dark gray ribbons from OSM highways. Blue surfaces are OSM water polygons clipped to the District 1 boundary, including the Saigon River, canals, lakes, and ponds. Green trees are OSM natural=tree nodes.
